source.title: Shop sourcing records: P3 leftovers of #3438
source.body:
Leftover Codjiflo P3 advisories from #3438 (shop records: sourcing of 37 to-order tools and gauges), logged at merge per the CNC fleet merge bar. Records only; none is a crash, collision or out-of-band finding.

### cad/config/shop-equipment/gauges.toml (https://github.com/pedropaulovc/harmonic-analyzer/pull/3438#discussion_r4662643225)
**[P3] Plus-tolerance ladder leaves R+.0001 reading unproven**

The PR now specifies the .4001–.4004 steps as plus tolerance (+.000040/-0). That proves the lower bound: a pin that enters shows the hole is at least R. It does not prove the upper bound in cad/process/ch_rocker_hub/plan.toml, which says "the hole lies in R to R + .0001" and sets `land_over_reading_min_in = 0.0005`. The next pin, nominal R+.0001, can measure up to R+.00014. A hole at R+.00013 therefore rejects it and reads as R.

Failure: the land is turned to R+.0005, so the interference is .0005 − .00013 ≈ .00037. That is below the drawing's .0004 minimum. With the earlier ± pins the worst case was the same, but this PR is the one that writes the tolerance direction down. Either add the .00004 gauge tolerance to `land_over_reading_min_in`, or state why the drawing's minimum absorbs it.

### cad/config/shop-equipment/tools-reamers-taps.toml (https://github.com/pedropaulovc/harmonic-analyzer/pull/3438#discussion_r4662643230)
**[P3] Stale 'no vendor/SKU' text contradicts new fields**

The PR adds make/sku/source/purchase to several records but leaves their notes and comments saying the opposite:
- `tools.reamer-2500` note (this line) still ends "No vendor or SKU asserted."
- the `tools.junior-hacksaw` comment (tools-hand.toml:252-253) says "No vendor or SKU is asserted".
- the `tools.hand-countersink-90` comment (tools-cutting.toml:265) says "No part number or price read."
- the `tools.tap-4-40-spiral-point` note (tools-taps.toml:83) says "source not chosen".
- the `tools.riser-countersink` comment (tools-cutting.toml:246) says "this record holds only ownership and use", yet the record now holds make/sku and a full product description.

Cost: a reader of the shop record cannot tell whether the supplier is chosen. Since "Each fact lives in exactly one file", the record contradicts itself. Update or remove these lines.

### cad/config/shop-equipment/tools-special-cutters.toml (https://github.com/pedropaulovc/harmonic-analyzer/pull/3438#discussion_r4662643237)
**[P3] Stamp purchase reasons from a superseded .14 callout**

The purchase justifies the 1/8 in set as "the nearest stock size under the sheet's .14 HIGH". The sheet no longer prints .14 HIGH. `test_fr_harmonic_base_drawing` pins `SERIAL_NOTE == 'STAMP "2"\n1/8 FIGURE STAMP'` (owner decision 2026-11-19, #3124 item 1).

The 1/8 set is correct, but the stated reason implies the shop is knowingly buying a character smaller than the sheet asks for. The unchanged note ("MHA-FR-01 STAMP \"2\" .14 HIGH") repeats the stale callout. Cite the sheet's 1/8 FIGURE STAMP instead.
